_meta.purpose: Contract for one logged decision (which policy fired, the verdict, the inputs).

title: Decision
description: An auditable record of a decision taken via a policy. Written by tools/policy.py.

subject.description: What the decision is about, e.g. a site or SKU name.

verdict.description: The outcome, e.g. GO / WATCH / NO / CUT / KEEP / BUY / HOLD.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons the policy produced this verdict.
